data.one_liner: A customizable switch widget with animations, custom colors, text, icons, and background images.
data.what_it_does: Provides an advanced switch control widget for Flutter supporting customized dimensions, thumb styles, active/inactive child widgets, background images, and state management via controllers or callbacks.
use_when: You need a highly customizable switch widget beyond the standard Material Switch.
You want to display text, icons, or background images inside active and inactive states of a toggle.
avoid_when: You only require a basic, out-of-the-box Material Design switch.
You need a platform-adaptive switch that matches native Cupertino styling automatically.
strengths: Supports custom thumb widgets, colors, text labels, icons, and background images.
Allows state management using either a ValueNotifier controller or an onChanged callback.
Smooth built-in animations and configurable dimensions.
weaknesses: Does not provide automatic platform-adaptive styling out of the box.
